description: Solve an uncoupled fluid-mechanical system in a specific number of steps (or divisions).

keywords.name: stages
keywords.description: Specify the number of stages over which to divide the fluid time. The default is 5 .

keywords.name: stage-save
keywords.description: If specified, after the end of each stage a save file will be made in the current directory. The save file will be named stageXX where XX is the number of the stage ( 0 prefix). If given the string sname will be used instead of stage .

keywords.name: stage-result
keywords.description: If specified, after the end of each stage a results file will be made in the current directory. The results file will be named stageXX where XX is the number of the stage ( 0 prefix). If given the string sname will be used instead of stage .

keywords.name: stage-fish
keywords.description: If specified, after each stage the FISH function sym will be called. If the FISH function takes an argument it will be set to the stage number starting at i1 .

examples.description: Solve 0.001 units of fluid time in 2 stages

notes: Accepted by the 9.8 PFC, FLAC, 3DEC, MPoint and MassFlow builds; 9.00 and 7.0 reject it.
Also takes the keywords of model solve.
